keySentences: Across 2023–2026, the Committee sought feedback from key stakeholders in legal academia, the legal profession and the general public; they are now considering the outcomes of this consultation.
The Committee is not accepting further feedback at this time.

The _Melbourne University Law Review_ and the _Melbourne Journal of International Law_ have embarked on consultations for a prospective new edition of the _AGLC_, spearheaded by the _AGLC5_ Committee ('Committee').
